title: Deterministic geometric class decisions on the fixed Step18 cohort
study_status: A declared computational follow-up after Step18 outcomes; not a fresh patient experiment or prospective confirmation
research_question: Can geometric constraints exclude a frozen regularity-constrained decoder class on the entire known cohort when sampling uncertainty is removed, and how does tightening the computational relaxation change the decision?

population.row_order: All 4096 saved Step18 calibration rows followed by all 4096 saved terminal rows, preserving each saved order
population.unit: One prespecified history/target pair per documented patient
population.target: The exact real value represented by each stored binary64 Step18 Y entry; normalized clipped lead-II amplitude 40ms ahead

frozen_models.class_metric: Maximum Euclidean distance over feature blocks
frozen_models.regularity: The same validation-selected kappa for each Step18 representation; all three selected kappas equal 1
frozen_models.class: All scalar kappa-Lipschitz decoders on each frozen canonical representation, clipped to the declared target range
frozen_models.reference: The frozen Step18 validation-selected HGB15 predictor

decision.margin: Exactly the existing Step18 10% MSE margin
decision.primary_rule: Exact rational full-cohort class lower > the unchanged stored Step18 threshold_upper
decision.reference_arithmetic_crosscheck: Also compare with exactly 11/10 times the exact mean squared loss of the frozen binary64 reference predictions and stored binary64 targets
decision.nonexclusion_means: Inconclusive; not proof of class adequacy
decision.exclusion_scope: This frozen representation, kappa, target, metric, and finite cohort; not unrestricted decoders or all KAHM geometries

constraint_schedule.base_partition_rule: The unchanged Step18 make_partition rule, applied to all 8192 nominal feature rows; greedy uses concatenated Euclidean distance, smallest-unused anchor, then nearest-unused distance/index ordering
constraint_schedule.larger_partition_rule: Concatenate adjacent pairs or quartets of the original 32-row groups within each family; do not rebuild greedy partitions at larger sizes
constraint_schedule.cross_family_combination: Take maximum of valid full-cohort lower bounds; never add overlapping partition SSE lower bounds
constraint_schedule.within_family_nesting: Every old edge remains in its parent block; extend child signed multipliers by zero on newly added edges

optimization.implementation: Unchanged Step18 signed-edge FISTA solver and canonical-radius correction, imported from frozen sources
optimization.initialization: Each new block QP starts from zero; child witness is separately preserved as a candidate, so this is not a warm-start speed comparison
optimization.iteration_limits: Retain and report the saved feasible dual regardless of convergence; do not change solver controls after outcomes
optimization.primal_scope: Block primal and gap diagnose the relaxed block program, not global canonical class optimality

exact_postverification.box_source: Stored Step18 F_lo and F_hi coordinatewise canonical-feature enclosures, with immutable input hashes
exact_postverification.box_quantization: Outward integer floor/ceil onto the 2^-28 grid; assert finite bounds and integer range safety
exact_postverification.edge_distance: For each feature block, sum squared maximum coordinate separations of the two integer boxes; take the maximum across blocks and its exact integer ceiling square root, then divide by 2^28
exact_postverification.arithmetic: Signed binary64 duals, stored binary64 targets, and kappa interpreted as exact dyadic rationals; dual linear term, distance penalty and divergence quadratic evaluated with integers/rationals
exact_postverification.witness_selection: Recursively choose maximum EXACT block dual objective among zero, the newly optimized signed dual, and the zero-extended exact-best child witnesses; choosing zero means zero multipliers
exact_postverification.aggregation: Sum exact selected objectives over the disjoint partition and divide by exactly 8192; retain an exact rational result and outward-rounded display bounds
exact_postverification.monotonicity: Nested selected exact objectives cannot decrease; verify exact inequalities before reporting
exact_postverification.numerical_scope: Exact arithmetic conditional on inherited feature-box inclusion and the explicitly stored-target/predictor semantics; not a formal verification of the upstream feature engine or measurement process

diagnostics.necessary_regularity_from_same_witness: Secondary deterministic interpretation only: preserve exact A=sum(linear-quadratic) and P=sum(D_Q*abs(lambda)) for each selected full-partition witness. For P>0, meeting the unchanged threshold requires kappa >= max(0,(A-M*threshold_upper)/P). Compare the exact-reference threshold as a crosscheck. If P=0 and A>M*threshold_upper, this witness excludes every finite kappa; otherwise it yields no positive lower requirement. Take maxima only within the same frozen geometry. This uses no new optimization or model selection, does not change the primary kappa=1 decision, and provides no adequacy guarantee above the necessary bound.
diagnostics.same_cohort_KL_comparison: Apply the former range-only KL map 4*kl_minus(d_M/4, log(180)/8192) as an explicitly unnecessary diagnostic penalty on the same full-cohort lower, never as the decision rule
diagnostics.historical_comparison_caution: Step18 n4096 versus Step19 M8192 changes observations as well as calibration; do not attribute that difference solely to removing the sampling penalty
